name: Minimum Semester Credits
source_text: A full-time undergraduate student must register for a minimum of 14.0 credits in each regular academic semester unless granted special medical or Dean dispensation.

name: Standard Semester Credit Cap
source_text: Students may register for a maximum of 22.0 credits in any standard semester without formal overload authorization.

name: Academic Overload Credit Cap
source_text: Students with a cumulative CGPA of 8.50 or higher and no outstanding backlogs may register for up to 24.0 credits per semester upon Dean of Academics approval.

name: Degree Total Credit Target
source_text: A candidate for the B.Tech degree must earn at least 142.0 credits distributed across Institute Core, Departmental Core, Electives, and Humanities components.

name: Prerequisite Chain Satisfaction
source_text: A student must obtain a passing grade (Grade D or above) in all hard prerequisite courses in a strictly earlier semester prior to registering for the advanced dependent course.

name: Semester Offering Parity
source_text: Courses designated as Autumn-only may only be scheduled in Odd semesters (1, 3, 5, 7); courses designated as Spring-only may only be scheduled in Even semesters (2, 4, 6, 8).

section_title: Minor Area in Computer Science Eligibility
name: Minor in Computer Science Eligibility
source_text: To earn a Minor Area in CSE, a non-CS student must possess a CGPA >= 7.50, complete 20 credits in COL courses including COL106, COL215, COL331, and COL362.

name: NPTEL/SWAYAM Online Credit Ceiling
source_text: Students may earn up to a maximum of 12.0 credits through approved MOOC platforms (NPTEL / SWAYAM) towards Open Electives, with a maximum of 1 course per semester.

section_title: Workload Optimization: Mutually Exclusive Theory Coursework
name: Workload Balance: Do Not Co-take Heavy Theory
source_text: Students are strongly advised not to register for COL351 (Design of Algorithms) and COL352 (Automata & Computation) in the same semester due to intense mathematical workload.

name: 100% Accredited Course Catalogue Citation
source_text: Every course scheduled in an official curriculum plan must correspond to a verified, active course offering in the IIT Delhi Courses of Study catalogue.

name: Zero Duplicate Course Registrations
source_text: A student may not register for a course in which they have already received a passing grade, nor schedule the same course in multiple future semesters.

section_title: Student Weekly Self-Study and Contact Hour Budget
name: Weekly Workload Feasibility
source_text: A student's total estimated weekly academic commitment (contact hours plus independent preparation) should not exceed their declared self-study availability.

name: Backlog Core Course Precedence
source_text: Students with an un-cleared core course backlog must prioritize scheduling that course at the earliest semester offering before registering for advanced electives.

name: Student Credit Ceiling Preference
source_text: Your declared credit preference: semester load respects your preferred workload cap unless minimum degree requirements mandate otherwise.

name: Student Course Separation Preference
source_text: Your declared preference: specified course pairs are scheduled in different semesters to balance exam stress and semester load.

name: Zero Redundant Instruction on Mastered Skills
source_text: Students who have demonstrated robust operational proficiency (BKT mastery >= 0.90 with verified evidence) should not be assigned introductory remedial instruction.
